name: td-nav
description: TradeDesk turn-by-turn drive. Thin MapKit wrapper: a native full-screen MKMapView follows the driver with a tilted camera, MKDirections supplies the route and its steps, and the plugin reports progress. Every decision (when to announce, when a deviation counts as off route, what the customer is told) lives in js/drive.js per CLAUDE.md 3.2.
